limits: Actual original instruction arrays executed by bundled Lua5.1 VM. Only size_t string length fields adapted from32 to64bits; no Lua instruction or numeric constant changed. This is not the original game embedded VM binary.

Engine APIs, champion iteration, HQ descriptors, symbolic input-lock values and timers are adapters. Original registration, message delivery, fade interpolation/audio mixing, rendering and latency not executed.
Default death-animation=false is native getter-qualified. True branch executes original Lua instructions but original configuration overrides remain unqualified.
Simulated timers prove requested callback deadlines and Lua call order, not the native timer scheduler implementation.
